releaseTitle: DocuEdit Pro v10.9.2 (Always-Visible Apply Actions & Keyboard Done Support)
changelog:
✨ Always-Visible Apply Controls & Mobile UX Overhaul:
• Triple Apply Buttons: Added a prominent 'Apply ✓' button right in the top header, a full-width 'Apply Replacement Now ✓' button directly beneath the text input box, and sticky bottom action buttons.
• Zero Button Cutoff: Middle controls wrapped in smooth vertical scrolling so buttons are never pushed off screen regardless of device size or screen aspect ratio.
• Keyboard IME Insets & Done Key: Added imePadding and wired keyboard 'Done' checkmark key to immediately commit text replacement without manual scrolling.
• Clean Vector Glyph Inpainting: Pure Paint.Style.FILL vector contours eliminate artificial ink-blob distortion.
• Resilient OCR Word Merging & Leftover Letter Alerts: Merges split word fragments and detects leftover characters with 1-tap correction.
